Name: Twin Tiger Shark
Overview:
Twin Tiger Shark is a biplane STG/shooter with its roots in the 80s.

- Online Hiscores
- TATE (Wide Screen 16:9) and Control Rotation Support
- 6 Stages - Loop forever or just 2 selection
- 3 Difficulty Settings
- 3 Weapon Types
- Helper Planes
- Smart Bombs
- No Continues
